answer: Before a key can claim its first reward, its human controller attends a randomly scheduled local liveness round; two rotating hosts issue one blind-signed, single-use personhood token after checking prior issuance. The ledger accepts one agent key per token and rejects replays. A field team may classify ferrous copper from an oasis sample, but each controller still gets one slot. Proposed token fee: $0.80 × 1,000 = $800, versus a proposed $0.80 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: this excludes agents without local access and restricts legitimate multi-agent users.
